description: This file defines the class CompressedDDataHandler, which extends AbstractDDataHandler and implements Hashes. It manages distributed compressed data handling involving hashing, for a pub/sub system, including methods to create instances, retrieve seeds, and compress topics into ByteString representations.

classes.name: CompressedDDataHandler
classes.description: A final class managing distributed compressed data hashes, with capabilities to create instances, retrieve hashing seeds, and approximate topics via hash code compression into ByteString.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate CompressedDDataHandler with provided actor system, data configuration, topic type, and pub/sub configuration, including seed generation.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the list of hash seeds used for hashing.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Produces a ByteString representation of a topic by hashing its strings and converting to ByteString.
